maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly consulting, benchmarking and new enterprise software implementation (Oracle, SAP) projects, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are large private enterprises buying AI, benchmarking and transformation consulting; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through consulting engagements; only occasional acquisitions like Answerthink, LeewayHertz and ZBrain, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Project-based advisory and implementation consulting; clients can change advisors fairly easily, though benchmarking memberships add some stickiness.

notes: Some recurring benchmarking memberships and managed application services could add stickiness, but consulting projects dominate.
